description:
Hushfeed v0.69.0 has 130 patches for global TikTok 47.0.3, 47.1.3 and 47.1.4 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

New patches bring picture-in-picture, App lock, Lock the feed, Block popups, a network proxy, SDR playback for HDR videos, a custom launcher icon and Run beside the store app. Fade the video controls dims everything over the video instead of hiding it, and Don't start the first video waits for your tap. What's new shows up in your phone's language.

Linked videos you've already seen open again, and leaving a LIVE doesn't close TikTok anymore with Remove LIVE extras. See the changelog for the full list.

Validation: 3558 runtime tests passed and 687 patch tests passed locally. Both Android lint checks passed. All 130 patches applied to all three supported APKs with resource and manifest checks. The attached release receipt identifies the exact source and bundle. Fade, picture-in-picture, Lock the feed and the first video hold were checked on a Samsung phone running TikTok 47.1.4.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. Refresh the Hushfeed source to update. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
